subsystems.name: Qubit array
subsystems.role: stores and processes quantum information in superconducting circuits.

subsystems.name: Control and readout
subsystems.role: manipulates qubit states and measures the result.

subsystems.name: Cryogenic system
subsystems.role: cools the chip to millikelvin temperatures so superconductivity and quantum coherence survive.

subsystems.name: Classical control electronics
subsystems.role: generates the microwave pulses and digitises the readout signals.

subsystems.name: Error correction and decoding
subsystems.role: combines many physical qubits into a smaller number of reliable logical qubits.
parts: surface code or other quantum codes

subsystems.name: Packaging and interconnects
subsystems.role: connects the chip to control lines and cooling while preserving signal integrity.

buildSteps.title: Design the qubit layout
buildSteps.detail: Electromagnetic simulation determines qubit frequencies, coupling strengths and control-line routing on the chip.

buildSteps.title: Fabricate the circuit
buildSteps.detail: Niobium films are deposited on a silicon or sapphire wafer, patterned by lithography, and etched to form capacitors and resonators.

buildSteps.title: Form Josephson junctions
buildSteps.detail: Aluminium is deposited and oxidised to create a thin tunnel barrier; junction area sets the qubit's nonlinearity.

buildSteps.title: Package the chip
buildSteps.detail: The die is flip-chip bonded or wire-bonded to a carrier that carries readout resonators and control lines.

buildSteps.title: Cool to millikelvin
buildSteps.detail: The package is mounted in a dilution refrigerator and cooled to about 10 mK, with attenuated and filtered microwave lines.

buildSteps.title: Calibrate the qubits
buildSteps.detail: Frequencies, coherence times and single- and two-qubit gate fidelities are measured and tuned.

buildSteps.title: Run error correction
buildSteps.detail: Repeated syndrome measurements detect errors; a real-time decoder identifies and corrects them.

buildSteps.title: Scale and integrate
buildSteps.detail: Qubit count and connectivity are increased while maintaining coherence, and the processor is linked to classical high-performance computers as an accelerator.

prerequisites.why: provides the nonlinear element that makes a controllable qubit.
superconducting qubits only operate near absolute zero, in the millikelvin range.
qubits are driven and measured with signals at a few gigahertz.
small codes have been demonstrated, but not yet at the scale needed for useful computation.
surface defects and two-level systems limit how long a qubit holds its state.
wiring thousands of qubits without overheating the refrigerator or corrupting signals is unsolved.

pathway.milestone: noisy intermediate-scale processors with tens to hundreds of physical qubits, accessible via cloud services
pathway.unlocks: algorithm research and early error-correction experiments.

pathway.milestone: logical qubits with error rates below the fault-tolerance threshold in small systems
fault-tolerant machines with hundreds of logical qubits
pathway.unlocks: quantum chemistry and materials simulations beyond classical reach.

pathway.milestone: large-scale quantum computers integrated with classical high-performance computing
pathway.unlocks: cryptographic and optimisation tasks, if error rates and qubit counts improve by many orders of magnitude.
